items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: I played with Dan Hughes, uh, Jack Lane, and different bands like that.

ctx.x: But you don't remember whose band it was?
I played with Dan Hughes, uh, Jack Lane, and different bands like that. All bands, your shilling used to play on the boat. They had all kinds of bands that played on the boat.
Did you ever work at the Silver Slipper before it was the Dream Room? No, no.
